title: The Death Race
logline: A reckless racer needs a pilot to clear the track of hazards before a massive gravity tide makes the annual death race entirely lethal.

roles.description: Adrenaline junkie, refuses to wear a seatbelt, heavily in debt.
A twisting, dangerous course through a dense asteroid field.
A heavily modified interceptor covered in spikes.
The syndicate that runs the bets and owns the racers.

public_situation: The {role:gambling_cartel} is hyping up the annual {role:race_track} event, promising record-breaking speeds.
private_truth: The bookie has rigged the race so the reckless racer will crash and die, ensuring a massive payout for the cartel.

beats.public_change: The racers line up at the starting grid.

missions.reason: The bookie pays the pilot to buy and deliver a batch of faulty thruster manifolds to the racer's pit crew.
missions.private_fact: The racer intercepts the delivery and realizes they are being set up.

beats.public_change: The race begins, and the rival racer immediately takes a suspicious shortcut.

missions.reason: The racer pays the pilot to scan the track for traps left by the rival.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the rival has deployed illegal proximity mines.

beats.public_change: The gravity tides suddenly spike, tearing massive rocks across the track.

missions.reason: The bookie panics as the odds shift and pays the pilot to disable the rival racer to ensure the reckless racer wins.
missions.private_fact: The rival hails the pilot, offering a cut of the cartel's purse if they let them finish the race instead.

resolutions.summary: The reckless racer crosses the finish line alive. The bookie is bankrupted by the payout, and the racer retires rich.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot cheated in the local death race to help an underdog win.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the rival's offer.
resolutions.summary: The rival crosses the finish line first. The reckless racer crashes into an asteroid and dies, and the cartel makes a fortune.
The gravity tide tears the track apart. The race is cancelled, all bets are voided, and everyone goes home angry.

loose_threads.detail: The gravity tide didn't just happen; someone deployed a massive grav-generator in the middle of the track.
The bookie reveals the cartel's betting pool is actually a money-laundering front for a pirate fleet.

radio_hooks: Odds shift wildly ahead of the annual death race.
{role:corrupt_bookie} promises the most exciting crash season yet.
